title: The Shoelace Taught Again
youtube_title: The Shoelace Taught Again | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Gita notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a shoelace taught again without the word 'already'. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Gita does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
